description: Leading product engineering for a streaming analytics platform — owning architecture from realtime ingestion to the dashboard experience, and shipping features used by 40k+ daily viewers.
Built client products end-to-end at a digital studio — design systems, marketing sites, and full SaaS applications for startups across fintech and health.
First engineering hire. Turned prototypes into a production design system and shipped the customer portal that carried the product to its first 10k users.
